title: P10 checks that would also pass without the property they claim, and P10 wording broader than the runs
what_went_wrong: A28 'rollback keeps the earlier staged rows': the retry re-backs-up rows identical to the ones already staged, so the stage checksums are equal whether or not the transaction rolled back; the check cannot fail on a missing rollback.
The integrated preservation experiment takes its 'pre' hashes after the injected failure and its restore, so a wrong restore would be recorded as the baseline and pass.
p10_hash_state.py turns an unavailable checksum (NULL) into the string 'None', which compares equal.
The preservation check does not assert the row count of its perturbing UPDATE, has no EXIT trap for its grant/database.xml changes, and tears down after a failed assertion.

R5 §21 says '13 populated stage tables' (13 tables, 21 rows in total, some empty) and 'crash-safe via the marker' (one SIGKILL placement tested; the marker is not fsynced and a malformed marker fails open).
root_cause: Each check was designed to pass on the fixed code, not to fail on the unfixed code; there was no negative control (deliberately broken implementation) for any of them.
detection: Astra v10 (gpt-6-astra run 4918967); each item re-verified against the source by the orchestrator on 2026-10-18.

correction.planned: P11: negative controls (break the rollback / skip the immediate restore and show the check FAILS); pre-operation snapshot; reject NULL checksums; assert perturbation counts; EXIT trap and keep-on-failure in the check; fsync + fail-closed marker; correct §21 wording (strike-through).
correction.status_note: Corrected in P11 on 2026-10-19/20. Evidence below; the P11 run set was executed against a frozen tool byte set (FROZEN.sha256 + chattr +i).

done.item_1_A28: A28' makes the live rows differ from the staged rows between the first backup and the faulty retry. discriminating: with R5_NEGCTL_BACKUP_NO_TXN the check FAILS, without it PASSES (evidence/p11/r5_p11_nc1_clean_20261020T010740Z.log); A28 PASS in r5_p6_acceptance_20261019T212302Z_FROZEN_39PASS.md.
done.item_2_baseline: p10_preservation_check.sh and the suite's P10_INJECT block take a pre-operation snapshot before the injected run and assert (a) immediate restoration, (b) stage preservation, (c) protected + live after the retry, separately (r5_p10_preservation_20261019T210238Z_NC5WITHOUT_PASS.md: 'PRESERVATION-RESULT a(sample-immediate)=EQUAL b(stage-preservation)=EQUAL c(protected-live)=EQUAL'); NC2: with R5_NEGCTL_SKIP_IMMEDIATE_RESTORE the check FAILS (2), without it PASSES.
done.item_3_hash: p10_hash_state.py exits 1 on a missing table, NULL checksum or empty inventory with a non-comparable ERROR:<table> value, and asserts the expected stage-table list (--stage-tables-list). Dropping one stage table on the kept fixture fails the preservation check (NC5: with=FAIL(2), without=PASS).
done.item_4_perturbation_trap: The perturbing UPDATE now asserts its changed-row count; an EXIT trap always restores database.xml and revokes the fixture grant; a failed assertion keeps the fixture and prints the teardown command. Forced failure (P11_FORCE_FAIL=2): one FAIL line, 'fixture sik_p6f is KEPT', keep-path PASS, 'PRESERVATION-CHECK FAIL (1)' (r5_p10_preservation_20261019T210740Z_FORCEFAIL_FAIL1_PASS.md).
done.item_5_marker_and_wording: Marker written temp+fsync+os.replace; malformed/unreadable marker fails closed (kept, exit 3, 'WRITER-EXCLUSION marker unreadable') with --recover-grants; the old fail-open path is shown by monkeypatch (unit test, 33/33). R5 §21 corrected with the numbers re-derived from evidence/p11/r5_p11_preserve_after_fail_20261019T2111Z.json (13 tables, 21 rows total, 5 non-empty, protected_n 20); 'crash-safe' now names the one tested fault placement; A10e's orphan-row scope stated.
